title: GPT and Prejudice: A Sparse Approach to Understanding Learned Representations in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It explicitly states that religion was a category considered for future work but was not included in the 11 social and moral categories that were probed (gender, family, marriage, wealth, emotion, love, scandal, duty, class, and society).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The analysis centered on themes of gender, marriage, class, and morality within nineteenth-century novels.
